summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on October 8, 2026, furnishing its Hong Kong Exchange monthly return for equity issuer movements in securities for the month ended September 30, 2026. The routine submission confirms no changes in authorized or issued shares, no treasury activity, unchanged balances across Class A and Class B WVR ordinary shares, and compliance with the 25% public float threshold; total shares outstanding remained 3,435,761,272. No special-situation event occurred—no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or management change. There is no deal or risk-arb angle; nothing to watch beyond future monthly returns.
